query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE status = $1 AND ((score IS NULL OR (score, id) < ($4, $3))) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL AND $4 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE status = $1 AND ((score IS NULL AND id < $3)) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL AND $4 IS NULL) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE status = $1 AND ($3 IS NULL) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN transfer_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.score desc nulls last, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
